description_en: Queries the details of a single client certificate or server certificate by using the unique identifier of the certificate
description_zh: 通过证书的唯一识别码查询单个客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息
name: DescribeClientCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the client certificate or server certificate that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html operation to query the unique identifiers of all client certificates and server certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

Certificate.description_en: The details of the client certificate or server certificate
Certificate.description_zh: 客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: 证书的到期日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Algorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm type of the certificate. Valid values:

RSA: RSA algorithm
ECC: ECC algorithm
SM2: SM2 algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

AliasName.description_en: The name of the issued certificate

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance date of the certificate. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: 证书的签发日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

CertChain.example:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
cert
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
subCA
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
rootCA
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

CertificateType.description_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

CLIENT: client certificate
SERVER: server certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:
证书的类型。取值：

CLIENT：表示客户端证书。
SERVER：表示服务端证书

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate

CountryCode.description_en:
The code of the country where the organization that is associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located.

For more information about country codes, see the Country code section in [Manage company information]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）
CountryCode.description_zh:
签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在国家的代码。

关于不同国家代码的含义，请参见[管理公司信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）中的**国际代号**章节

CustomIdentifier.description_en: The custom identifier, which serves as a unique key
CustomIdentifier.description_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键

Days.description_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: days

FullAlgorithm.description_en: The algorithm that includes the key length

Id.description_en: The ID of the data source to which the certificate order belongs

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the certificate

Locality.description_en: The name of the city where the organization that is associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located
Locality.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the certificate

Organization.description_en: The name of the organization that is associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate
Organization.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the department under the organization that is associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate
ParentIdentifier.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书的唯一识别码

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the certificate belongs

Sans.description_en:
The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension attribute of the certificate, which indicates other domain names and IP addresses that are associated with the certificate.

The value of this parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct that corresponds to a SAN extension.
Each SAN extension struct includes the following parameters:

Type: the type of the extension. This parameter is of the INTEGER type. Valid values:
1: email address
2: domain name
6: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)
7: IP address
Value: the content of the extension. This parameter is of the STRING type
Sans.description_zh:
证书的SAN（Subject Alternative Name）扩展属性，表示证书关联的其他域名、IP地址等。

该参数使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，对应一个SAN扩展。
每个SAN扩展结构体包含以下参数：

Type：Integer类型，表示扩展的类型。取值：
1：表示邮箱地址。
2：表示域名。
6：表示统一资源标志符URI（Uniform Resource Identifier）。
7：表示IP地址。
Value：String类型，表示扩展的内容

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the certificate

State.description_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization that is associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization that is associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located.</props>
State.description_zh:
<props="china">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: The certificate is issued.
REVOKE: The certificate is revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书的状态。取值：

ISSUE：表示正常签发。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

SubjectDN.description_en:
The distinguished name (DN) attribute of the certificate, which indicates the subject of the certificate. The attribute includes the following information:

C: Country.
O: Organization.
OU: Organizational unit.
L: Locality.
<props="china">- ST: Province, municipality, or autonomous region.</props>
<props="intl">- ST: Province or state.</props>
CN: Common name
SubjectDN.description_zh:
证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：国家。
O：组织机构。
OU：部门。
L：城市。
<props="china">- ST：省份、直辖市或自治区。</props>
<props="intl">- ST：省份或州。</props>
CN：公用名

UploadFlag.description_en: Indicates whether the synchronization of the digital certificate to the Certificate Service is complete
UploadFlag.description_zh: 表示该证书是否已同步到数字证书服务
